definitions.explanation: The area surrounding or near something.
Related or supplementary items; the outer edges.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}→期間中：23950_kikanchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧{周辺|しゅうへん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Security around the venue was strengthened during the Olympics.
There are many shops in the area around the station.

examples.japanese: {周辺|しゅうへん}⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I bought all the peripheral devices.
